_smokey_adams_: Quentin Adams left twin brothers too young to enlist behind in Coldwater and came up the line with a letter he never sent. The men noticed at once that he will not eat before a raid.
Word came down the line: Verdel Ridge is ours. Quentin Adams shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Isidor Glc and Quentin Adams tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
Quentin Adams wrote a letter for Edmund Crack's mother, because Edmund could not find the words. Edmund signed it.

A bullet went through Quentin Adams's sleeve at R-F8 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils "Hollow" Jozifanderso of the Hegemony (@jozifanderson). The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Hill 304. Quentin Adams read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
Quentin Adams no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
A rat stole Quentin Adams's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier.
The kettle lid rattled whenever the conversation stopped. Quentin Adams put a folded cloth beneath it and immediately missed the noise.
autistic_monkey3: After 3 days of war, S-F20 had a place for everything. On Day 4, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Florian Monkey.
A shell hit the latrine at S-F20. Nobody was hurt. Florian Monkey says it was the best day of the war.

Wiring party. Florian Monkey held the coil while two others pulled. Twenty yards of new wire at S-F20, and everyone came back. Dawn watch. Florian Monkey put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Cyril Miller, grazed. The Hegemony hold Hill 304 now, and they can see straight into S-F20. Florian Monkey has learned to walk bent double.
Florian Monkey and Leopold Ker made a pact on sentry tonight: whoever gets home first visits the other's family. They shook on it.
Florian Monkey fired at a movement across the wire at S-F20. The man went down: Konrad "Crow" Dinhdong, grazed.
Florian Monkey got a letter from Josef. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most.
es31230: The new machine gunner is Edmund "Whistle" Es, once a shepherd from Coldwater. The corporal asked if a shepherd was any use in a trench. Edmund "Whistle" Es said he would find out.
The first hundred were recognised, and Edmund "Whistle" Es was among them. He wrote the news on the back of an unfinished letter.
Edmund "Whistle" Es wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
At the Weeping Orchard, Albin Chloe of the Hegemony and Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord fired at the same loose sheet of metal. The wind kept winning.
Verdel Ridge has been won. Edmund "Whistle" Es listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es of the Concord and Emil Theramblingb of the Hegemony watched a broken branch near Hill 304 all morning. Neither could risk assuming it was only a branch.
Edmund "Whistle" Es fired twice at the enemy post. The second shot found Zeno Smiridisnick, badly wounded. Nobody nearby said anything.

Edmund "Whistle" Es saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close. From Hill 304 the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Edmund "Whistle" Es wrote to the people he used to know that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Edmund "Whistle" Es lifted the trench periscope and found a spider across the mirror. For one startled second, the enemy seemed enormous.
Clement "Saint" Yokley held the mirror while Edmund "Whistle" Es shaved. The arrangement survived the shaving but not the comments.

Edmund "Whistle" Es had marked the corner of the enemy trench with two stakes in daylight. At night the gun fired between the stakes, blind. Jakub Virajvirxgil was grazed. A letter from home found Edmund "Whistle" Es before the night shift. Edmund "Whistle" Es folded it small and kept it close.
yijoon09: They issued Pavel Yijoon a rifle, a spade and a number. He kept a key to a house that is no longer there in his breast pocket, where the shrapnel would have to go through it first.

The patrol came back one man at a time. Pavel Yijoon held the gap open and counted until the corporal said that was everyone. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Yijoon. Pavel Yijoon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Pavel Yijoon wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.

Dawn watch. Pavel Yijoon put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Arno Coopergfulto, badly wounded. Mail came up the line with a letter for Pavel Yijoon. Pavel Yijoon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
A scrap of newspaper advertised a sale of garden furniture. Pavel Yijoon worked out how many months of pay a comfortable afternoon would cost.
Pavel Yijoon fired at the enemy dawn watch from R-F23. Gideon "Ghost" Marks was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down.
